summary: One-line change makes Contains.as_set return the containing set (args[1]) instead of raising NotImplementedError, correctly resolving the Piecewise AttributeError since the set of values satisfying x ∈ S is S itself. Minimal, correct for the reported case, and consistent with as_set semantics.

issues.description: Returns args[1] unconditionally, so for a non-trivial element expression (e.g. Contains(x+1, S)) the result is not the true solution set of the free symbol but the raw set S. Acceptable for the typical symbol-membership case and matches sympy's loose as_set usage, but not a fully general solution.
No docstring/comment added explaining why as_set returns the containing set; a brief note would aid future maintainers.
